Solara - (9.4) QUASAR

JUXTAPOSITION

"Juxtaposition"

CONCEPT

Spida saves the day — he and Catipala pull SOLARA through the northwest gate (the same light). They emerge at Level 29, Fold 1 — back where they started. Happy reunion. Names shared. Chaos and Disorder just being Chaos and Disorder. Mayhem, Havoc and Ruin enthusiastically break important things. But SOLARA does not remember any of it. She does not know who she is.
